verdict.rationale: Testing in a sandbox without touching production data is a fair question for a DevOps platform like GitLab, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only covers CI/CD-triggered security scans, MR annotations and agent guardrails. Nothing documents an isolated sandbox or test environment that is separated from production data, and CI pipelines running scans are an adjacent capability rather than sandbox isolation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
